title: docs: clarify transport error in podman-save man page
body:
## What type of PR is this?
/kind documentation

## What this PR does / why we need it
This PR improves the `podman-save` man page to address issue #20775 by documenting why the "unsupported transport" error occurs and how to avoid it.

As noted in the issue comments, the man page currently doesn't clarify that `podman save` requires images in local storage. This documentation fix complements the ongoing work on improving the error message itself.

## Which issue(s) this PR fixes
Fixes #20775

## Changes
- Added new "Image References and Transports" section to `podman-save.1.md.in`
- Explains that `podman save` only works with images in local storage
- Shows incorrect usage (`podman save docker://alpine`) and the resulting error
- Provides correct workflow: pull the image first, then save without transport prefix
- Clarifies that `docker://` refers to container registries, not local storage
- Cross-references `podman-pull` for more transport information

## Context
This addresses the documentation aspect raised by @rwmjones in the issue comments, where they noted the man page doesn't explain that images must be pulled first. This complements the code-level error message improvements being worked on separately.

## Testing
- Built documentation with `make docs` - builds successfully
- Verified markdown syntax follows MANPAGE_SYNTAX.md guidelines
- Added proper examples with shell prompts ($)

## Notes for reviewers
This is a documentation-only change that makes an existing error message more actionable by explaining the correct usage pattern in the man page. This works alongside the planned code-level error message improvements for a complete solution.
